mapper.sql: SELECT s.seal_id, s.seal_name, s.seal_code, s.seal_category, s.seal_type, s.enable_date, s.org_name, s.dept_id, s.seal_file_path, s.default_size_mm, s.size_options, s.cert_path, s.key_path, s.cert_info, s.cert_id, s.key_ref, s.cert_bind_mode, s.status, s.del_flag, s.remark, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, d.name AS dept_name, (SELECT di.label FROM sys_dict_item di INNER JOIN sys_dict sd ON di.dict_id = sd.id WHERE sd.code = 'sign_seal_category' AND di.value COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = s.seal_category AND di.deleted = 0 AND sd.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1) AS category_label FROM sign_seal s LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON s.dept_id = d.id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sign_seal WHERE seal_id = #{sealId} AND del_flag = '0' FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sign_seal ( seal_name, seal_code, seal_category, seal_type, enable_date, org_name, dept_id, seal_file_path, default_size_mm, size_options, cert_path, key_path, cert_info, cert_id, key_ref, cert_bind_mode, status, del_flag, remark, create_by, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{sealName}, #{sealCode}, #{sealCategory}, #{sealType}, #{enableDate}, #{orgName}, #{deptId}, #{sealFilePath}, #{defaultSizeMm}, #{sizeOptions}, #{certPath}, #{keyPath}, #{certInfo}, #{certId}, #{keyRef}, #{certBindMode}, #{status}, '0', #{remark}, #{createBy}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update:

mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT('YZ', LPAD( IFNULL(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(seal_code, 3) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) + 1, 3, '0')) FROM sign_seal WHERE seal_code IS NOT NULL AND seal_code LIKE 'YZ%'

INSERT INTO sign_seal_sequence (seq_name, current_value, increment) VALUES ('seal_code', 0, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE current_value = current_value + increment;
SELECT CONCAT('YZ', LPAD(CAST( (SELECT current_value FROM sign_seal_sequence WHERE seq_name = 'seal_code') AS UNSIGNED), 3, '0')) AS next_code
